contents.text: <instructions>Match the words to the pictures.</instructions>
Vowels can be short or long. A long vowel says its name. A short vowel does not.

header.text: The letter a is a vowel. When a is followed by just consonants, a does not say its name. It makes a short a sound (/ă/) instead.
When a is followed by a consonant and a silent e, a says its name. It makes a long a sound (/ā/).
When a is followed by another vowel, the two vowels can make a vowel team. In vowel teams that start with a, a says its name. It makes a long a sound. The other vowel is silent.

title.text: Mizuna mustard, 'Outredgeous' red romaine lettuce, and 'Waldmann’s Green' lettuce

paragraphs.text: Getting vegetables to people in a space station is not easy. Food must be sent a long way from Earth. And fresh vegetables spoil soon after they are picked. So, people are learning to grow vegetables in space.

The first vegetable grown and eaten in space was lettuce. Scientists had to make special containers to grow the lettuce plants. They also had to use fans and colored lights to help the plants grow. Scientists are now working on growing other types of food in space as well.
People in space still get most of their food from Earth. But if they could grow their own food, they could travel even farther from Earth. That would open up a whole new world of space travel.

Listen and read along with the passage about tumbleweeds.

paragraphs.text: Tumbleweeds are often seen rolling across American deserts and grasslands. Tumbleweeds look like large balls of sticks that were twisted together. But they are actually dead plants.

When some plants die, they can break from their roots in one big piece. Then the wind blows the dead plants around. The plants tumble, or roll, across the ground. This is what gives tumbleweeds their name.

Tumbleweeds are common in the American West. But most plants that make tumbleweeds are actually from other countries. Some people believe the plants were brought to the United States by mistake. They think seeds from tumbleweed plants were probably mixed in with seeds used to grow food.
Farmers from other countries brought these seeds to America. Then they planted the seeds. Tumbleweed plants grew alongside the food plants. That is how tumbleweeds may have first come to America.

Tumbleweeds are common in the American West. But most plants that make tumbleweeds are actually from other countries. Some people believe the plants were brought to the United States by mistake. They think seeds from tumbleweed plants were probably mixed in with seeds used to grow food.
Farmers from other countries brought these seeds to America. Then they planted the seeds. Tumbleweed plants grew alongside the food plants. That is how tumbleweeds may have first come to America.

paragraphs.text: Everyone sneezes from time to time. Even small babies sneeze. But have you ever wondered why you sneeze?

Sneezing is your body's way of protecting itself. You sneeze to help keep harmful things, like dirt and dust, out of your body. Sneezing is something that your body does to stop you from getting sick.
Your nose works like a small guard for your body. It is lined with many tiny hairs. The hairs help trap small things that enter your nose when you breathe in.
When something gets stuck on a hair, a signal is sent to your brain to tell you to sneeze. When you sneeze, air rushes out of your nose. And so does whatever was trapped on the hair!

Listen and read along with the passage about mangrove trees.

paragraphs.text: Most trees do not grow well near the ocean's edge. But that is the place mangrove trees call home. Mangroves are different from other trees. They can live in salty ocean water.

Salt is harmful to most trees, but mangroves are able to protect themselves. The trees can get rid of salt by pushing it out of their leaves. Also, mangrove roots help keep too much salt from getting into the tree.
Mangrove roots can be seen above the water, but they have an important job under the water. The roots provide a home for many animals. Fish often hide their babies near the roots to keep them safe.
Mangrove roots also help protect the land on the coast. They keep the land from being washed away by storms. Mangrove roots and leaves are part of what makes the mangrove tree special.

title.text: Steam vent tower on Mount Erebus, Antarctica

paragraphs.text: Imagine walking through Antarctica. It is very, very cold. Everything is covered with snow and ice.
You probably wouldn't expect to see a huge volcano filled with hot lava. But that is what you might find! Antarctica has a volcano called Mount Erebus.

Sometimes the heat from Mount Erebus escapes through cracks in the frozen ground. When the heat meets the cold air outside, it makes steam. The steam freezes right away because the air is so cold. As steam keeps pouring out and freezing, it builds a hollow tower of ice.
Ice towers can be as tall as sixty feet! They sometimes look like giant white chimneys with smoke coming out. These huge ice towers are found all around Mount Erebus.

paragraphs.text: What would it feel like to walk through a cloud? People who have been in fog know what it's like. Fog is a cloud that is on the ground.

Clouds and fog are formed the same way. There are tiny water droplets in the air all around us. When the air cools down, the droplets stick together to make a cloud. This usually happens high up in the sky. But fog is special because it is formed low to the ground.
Fog usually appears in the morning or at night. That is when it is cool outside. When the sun comes out, it warms up the air. This often causes the fog to disappear.
Fog can be hard to see through, so it can be dangerous. If you are not looking closely, you could run into something. So, you have to be careful when you walk through these clouds.

paragraphs.text: Getting vegetables to people in a space station is not easy. Food must be sent a long way from Earth. And fresh vegetables spoil soon after they are picked. So, people are learning to grow vegetables in space.

The first vegetable grown and eaten in space was lettuce. Scientists had to make special containers to grow the lettuce plants. They also had to use fans and colored lights to help the plants grow. Scientists are now working on growing other types of food in space as well.
People in space still get most of their food from Earth. But if they could grow their own food, they could travel even farther from Earth. That would open up a whole new world of space travel.
